title: Linking via unique account identifier
description: Homeowner shares a unique identifier (e.g., email or username) when registering the account, enabling linking of this registration action and subsequent enrollments to the individual.

title: Processing of identified registration data
description: The Home Hub receives and processes identified personal data (account details, device enrollment info) from the homeowner to create and associate the account.

title: Attributable registration record
description: Account registration and camera/sensor enrollment creates a persistent data record that attributes these actions to the specific homeowner, preventing later denial.

title: Implicit disclosure via enrollment metadata
description: The data flow for registration and enrollment implicitly discloses metadata about the homeowner's devices and home setup to the Home Hub.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not explicitly detail metadata contents, so this is inferred from typical registration flows.

title: Temporary access code as unique identifier
description: The temporary access code entered by the guest serves as a unique (locally within the system) identifier that can link the door-unlock event and timing to this specific guest user.

title: Logged access prevents denial of entry action
description: Receipt and potential logging of the temporary access code at the Home Hub creates attributable evidence of the guest's presence and action, preventing repudiation of having unlocked the door.

title: Guest unaware of further processing of access event
description: The guest user entering the code may be unaware that the access event or code usage could be collected, stored or further processed beyond the immediate unlock.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not explicitly mention logging or storage, so this is inferred from typical hub behavior.

title: Sensitive activity data stored locally
description: Motion/door/sensor events written to the local event log can reveal highly sensitive information about inhabitants' presence, movements and daily routines.

title: Profiling via stored sensor events
description: The local event log enables long-term analysis of motion/door/sensor patterns to profile individual behavior and habits.

title: Attributable evidence of home activities
description: Event records in the log can be used as evidence to attribute specific actions or presence to individuals, preventing plausible deniability.

title: Disclosure of sensitive camera footage to cloud
description: The upload of recorded camera clips discloses highly sensitive personal visual data (images of individuals and home activities) to the cloud video storage provider.

title: Identifiable information transmitted in clips
description: The data flow carries camera clips from which the identity of data subjects may be derived through visual content such as faces and behaviors.

title: Video clips as attributable evidence
description: Stored camera clips constitute data records that can be attributed to individuals and used to prevent denial of claims about their actions or presence.

title: Profiling via motion pattern analysis
description: Real-time motion alerts received by the backend enable analysis of presence patterns and behavior of individuals in the home, linking data to specific data subjects through profiling.

title: Disclosure of sensitive motion data
description: Home Hub shares motion alert data which reveals sensitive information about home occupancy and activity, a data type that may be perceived as highly sensitive depending on context.

title: Identified information in communication metadata
description: The data flow may carry metadata (e.g. device IDs, timestamps, network identifiers) that identifies the source or user associated with the motion alert.
uncertainty_note: Not explicitly stated in flow description whether metadata contains identified info; inferred from typical IoT alert flows.

title: Observed communications revealing motion detection events
description: An external observer monitoring the data flow can detect the push of motion-detected notifications, thereby inferring activity or presence at the homeowner's property.

title: Identified information in push notification metadata
description: The metadata of the communication flow contains identified information (such as device tokens or user identifiers) required to deliver the notification specifically to the homeowner's phone.

title: Disclosure of sensitive motion event data
description: The backend shares data about motion detection events, which can be perceived as highly sensitive personal information regarding home security and occupancy.

title: Sharing aggregated analytics with external vendor
description: The mobile app backend shares aggregated device-usage analytics with a predetermined external cloud analytics vendor, exposing the data to an additional party.

title: User unawareness of analytics sharing
description: Data subjects may be unaware that their device-usage analytics are being aggregated and shared with a cloud analytics vendor by the backend.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not specify user notification mechanisms

title: Propagation to analytics vendor
description: Analytics data becomes accessible to the cloud vendor which may not be strictly needed for core functionality.
uncertainty_note: Depends on whether vendor processing is required or excessive

title: Sensitive video data transferred
description: Video clip is sensitive personal data being retrieved and transferred to the backend for playback, with risk of disclosure if not properly protected.

title: Revealing attributes via video content
description: The retrieved video clip contains visual attributes (e.g., faces, home interior) that can identify the homeowner or other individuals.

title: Video clip as attributable evidence
description: Stored and retrieved video serves as a data record that can attribute presence or actions to the homeowner, preventing denial of claims.
